launcher.loadError: The list of presentations cannot be loaded.
launcher.localText: Open the presentation, then press S for the speaker view with notes and timer. Move the presentation window to the projector's extended display and keep the speaker view on your screen.
launcher.serverHeading: Two computers, synchronized through this server
launcher.serverText: Open this page at the address of the online service. After starting the session, open the control link on your own device and the projection link on the projector's computer.
launcher.presenterLink: Open the control presentation, then press S for notes
launcher.audienceUrlLabel: Short address for the projector and the audience
launcher.audienceUrlText: This address opens the latest session started by the presenter, without a password and without access to the controls or the notes.
launcher.sessionReady: Session ready. The projection link can only follow the presentation.
launcher.relayText: No server of your own is needed: a relay forwards slide changes from your device to every open projection link. Slide positions travel through a third-party service; speaker notes are never sent.
launcher.relayFailed: The relay did not answer. Check its address or try again later.
launcher.relayAudienceUrlLabel: Projection link for the projector and the audience
launcher.relayReady: Relay session ready. Keep this tab open: the control link only works in this tab.

sync.missingKey: Session control is missing. Start a session from the main page.
sync.relayMissingSecret: The relay control secret is missing in this tab. Start a relay session from the main page.

server.sessionExpired: The session does not exist or has expired.
server.deckMismatch: The presentation does not match the session.
server.nowHeading: The presentation has not started yet
server.nowText: There is no active session. This page checks again every 5 seconds; you can leave it open.
